notes.title: UI feedback and pollen changes
notes.notes:
. Add feedbacks on interfaces for:
[list]
[*]Pollen quantity by second you earn on pollen bar
[*]Pollen quantity needed on hovering the pollen menu
[*]Stats added when leveling up a plant, on hovering the level up button
[/list]

One thing that came, when playing on highest levels with the new flowers balance, is that pollen active skill was too powerful on level start and too weak at the end and it was too "spamming". I added some improvement and behavior changes to have a more growing power and cost that bring a skill that need to be used less frequently but with greatest effects:
. Add an upgrade in the garden, for the Solariane, that upgrade all pollen power by 5% and increase pollen cost by 1, with 10 levels
. The pollen skill cost increase by 1 for each flower and the pollen area ticks its attacks 1 time more for each flower

notes.title: The challeng update!
notes.notes:
[h2]The challenge update![/h2]
Today, a global upgrade of the Sacrifice Tree, in the Garden:
[list]
[*]Modification of the Nibblers bodies number bar, for a more comprehensive feature and a better look
[*]Adding a visual effect, at the bottom of the Sacrifice tree and in the Sacrifice menu, to show up the corpses consume skill is ready to use
[*]Upgrading the corpses stock is cheaper
[*]Increasing the number of cells earned by consuming the corpses
[*]Adding difficulty unlock buttons, that need corpses to be unlocked
[*]As soon as you'll unlock the first difficulty upgrade, the button for difficulty choice for level 1 and 2 will appear
[/list]

[h3]Levels of difficulty[/h3]
[list]
[*]Level 1 : Base difficulty, no modification
[*]Level 2 : The creatures get stronger over time, in addition to normal difficulty increase. Cells reward +10%
[*]Level 3 : More difficulty increase and new creatures and new creatures appear. Cells reward +20%
[*]Level 4 : Nibblers are, again, more powerful and the Overlords come into battle!. Cells reward + 30%
[*]Add one new creature for level 3: Slugiciola, a bulky Nibbler that spread slime that spead up creature getting on it
[*]Add one new creature for level 4: Overlord, a mighty Nibbler that walk slowly and spit mucus that  increase armor and max life of others creatures
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.53 + 0.54: Maps, balancing and new plants
notes.notes:
[h2]Version 0.53 +  0.54: Maps, balancing and new plants[/h2]
Due to an error, the patch note for v0.53 did not passed, so here are the last two versions:

[list]
[*] Bonus maps 5 and 6 is fixed
[*] Add a shortcut for pollen zone (e by default for now)
[*] Light increase for Slapper and Grinder damage, to be more effective on raw damage type of plant
[*] Adding a preview on plant range before buying it
[*] Light increase for mushrooms range, reflecting a more area of damage type of plants
[*] Increase of biomass gain from Digestiflore skill, to get the use of flower more rewarding
[*] Add lmaps 30 to 35 and bonus 7, 8 and 9
[*] Add new plants: Crusher, Skinner and Spreader
[*] Add a new biomass starting bonus in the graden, in Fruit upgrades
[*] Change base starting price for all 4 branches of plants to 30 biomass and all base plant have a cost upgrade that have a max elvel 5... find your way to fight with all starting the same cost! 
[*] Add a visual effect to show progression road between levels, on main map
[/list]
